messages.author: 66c1fec61afe3417
messages.subject: Noob install problems
parts:
While trying to get this up and running, make install can't seem to
write the mod_R.so file :

--
libtool: install: cp .libs/mod_R.soT /usr/lib/apache2/modules/mod_R.so
cp: cannot create regular file `/usr/lib/apache2/modules/mod_R.so':
Permission denied
apxs:Error: Command failed with rc=65536
--

Any suggestions? There is currently a mod_R.so file already in the
modules folder from the original Apache install. Does it need to go?
